title: bug: JetBrains drops latestCheckRun.outcome, so a non-passed exit-0 check displays as passed
description:
Filed by governor-693b7073 on architect-8419009e's report (#architects msg-b280b4ba, 16:36Z). It is V12's client hand-forward, and nothing owned it: searching the board for 'latestCheckRun' finds only V12b.

**Daemon side (landed).** V12b (task-6339299a, DONE) projects `latestCheckRun.outcome` in the task's delivery projection (packages/moe-daemon/src/state/deliveryProjection.ts, checkFor). The values are CHECK_OUTCOMES: passed, code-failure, infra-failure, timeout, skipped, inconclusive. The field is omitted when the row has no outcome.

**JetBrains side (the bug).** The client reads only command, exitCode and source:
- `data class DeliveryCheckRun(command, exitCode, source)` in moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/model/Models.kt;
- parsing in moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/util/MoeJson.kt (around :440);
- rendering in moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/DeliveryPresentation.kt (around :22-29).
So an exit-0 check whose outcome is timeout, infra-failure, skipped or inconclusive renders like a pass.

**Scope: JetBrains only.**
- Models.kt, MoeJson.kt, DeliveryPresentation.kt, moe-jetbrains/src/main/resources/messages/MoeBundle.properties, plus a JetBrains unit test.
- An absent outcome (an older daemon, or a row recorded without one) keeps today's exitCode-based rendering.
- VS Code renders no latestCheckRun at all. Whether it should gain a delivery-check view is a parity decision for the human, so it is out of scope here; note it in the completion summary.

**Ordering.** This row dependsOn CQ-I06f (task-426a012e). I06f's whole-epic review may fix residuals forward in MoeBundle.properties (for example the stale PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND "on PATH" text, comment-ca3c8ccb on I06), so the two rows must not edit that file at the same time. Run the gradle gate in an isolated copy under the `jetbrains-gradle` lease (GLOBAL rule 0).
definitionOfDone: JetBrains parses latestCheckRun.outcome: DeliveryCheckRun gains outcome, and MoeJson reads it. DeliveryPresentation renders every non-passed outcome (code-failure, infra-failure, timeout, skipped, inconclusive) distinctly from passed, even when exitCode is 0. The user-visible strings live in MoeBundle.properties.

A JetBrains unit test pins three cases: an exit-0 check with a non-passed outcome renders as not passed; outcome passed renders as passed; and an absent outcome falls back to today's exitCode rendering.

A fresh `cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` passes, run in an isolated copy under the jetbrains-gradle lease (the labelled Windows equivalent on this host), and its output is supplied to complete_task.
VS Code is untouched, and the completion summary notes the VS Code delivery-check parity question for the human.
